title: Market Match for Signed Home-Site Lease Renewals, by Lot Class
content:
The rent at which a twelve-month renewal of the Home-Site Lease is signed is set by the market match, which compares the offered rent — the monthly site rent of the twelve-month renewal offer on the lease — with the lot class's base monthly site rent for new residents and with the full calendar months of tenancy since the move-in date.

| Offered rent | Full months of tenancy | Rent the twelve-month renewal is signed at |
|---|---|---|
| above the base rent | 60 or more | the base rent (the lesser of the two) |
| above the base rent plus 15.00 | at least 24 but fewer than 60 | the base rent plus 15.00 |
| any other combination | — | the offered rent |

**Base rent and base rent plus 15.00, by lot class**

| Lot class | Base monthly site rent (USD) | Base rent plus 15.00 |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 587.00 | 602.00 |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 621.00 | 636.00 |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 668.00 | 683.00 |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 709.00 | 724.00 |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 752.00 | 767.00 |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 839.00 | 854.00 |

**Hypothetical cases on a Standard Multi-Section site (base rent 668.00)**

| Offered rent | Tenure | Signed at | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| 700.00 | 70 months | 668.00 | above the base rent, 60 months or more |
| 700.00 | 60 months | 668.00 | the 60-month threshold is met on reaching it |
| 700.00 | 59 months | 683.00 | above 683.00, 24 to 59 months |
| 700.00 | 24 months | 683.00 | the 24-month threshold is met on reaching it |
| 700.00 | 23 months | 700.00 | fewer than 24 months |
| 680.00 | 30 months | 680.00 | not above 683.00 |
| 660.00 | 70 months | 660.00 | not above the base rent |
